build.template: Build the solution by running `dotnet build Facware.ModularMonolith.slnx`. If it fails with a mixed-toolchain artifact error (e.g. `RZ3600: Invalid value '10.0' for RazorLangVersion`), clean the shared bin/obj first with the `/clean` command and rebuild. Report the number of warnings and errors.

test.description: Run all tests inside WSL (required - WebApplicationFactory hangs over the UNC path)
test.template: Run the tests from inside WSL with `wsl -- bash -lc "cd ~/projects/architecture/ModularMonolith && dotnet test Facware.ModularMonolith.slnx"`. Always run tests via WSL, never directly from Windows over the `\\wsl.localhost\...` UNC path. Report Passed/Failed counts.$ARGUMENTS

test:integration.description: Run the API integration tests inside WSL
test:integration.template: Run the integration test project inside WSL with `wsl -- bash -lc "cd ~/projects/architecture/ModularMonolith && dotnet test tests/Facware.ModularMonolith.Api.IntegrationTests/Facware.ModularMonolith.Api.IntegrationTests.csproj"`. Always run via WSL, never from Windows over the UNC path. Report Passed/Failed counts.$ARGUMENTS

test:architecture.description: Run the architecture tests inside WSL
test:architecture.template: Run the architecture test project inside WSL with `wsl -- bash -lc "cd ~/projects/architecture/ModularMonolith && dotnet test tests/Facware.ModularMonolith.ArchitectureTests/Facware.ModularMonolith.ArchitectureTests.csproj"`. Always run via WSL, never from Windows over the UNC path. Report Passed/Failed counts.$ARGUMENTS

run.template: Run the API with `dotnet run --project src/Facware.ModularMonolith.Api/Facware.ModularMonolith.Api.csproj`. It serves HTTP http://localhost:5225 and HTTPS https://localhost:7102. OpenAPI is available at /openapi/v1.json in Development.

clean.description: Clean shared bin/obj artifacts (fixes Windows/WSL mixed-toolchain build errors)
clean.template: Clean the shared bin/obj directories (used by both the Windows and WSL toolchains) with `wsl -- bash -lc "cd ~/projects/architecture/ModularMonolith && find src tests -type d \( -name bin -o -name obj \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} +"`. Run this when a build fails with mixed-toolchain errors such as RZ3600.
